title: [QM] Fix internal put-away from Quality Inspection sourcing wrong bin
summary: Internal put-away disposition from Quality Inspection now resolves the source bin from actual Bin Content in directed put-away locations instead of relying on field naming conventions, fixing errors when items no longer exist in their original receive bins.
key_points: Resolves source bins from real Bin Content for bin-mandatory locations, excluding receive and adjustment bins
Validates source bins for receive-bin issues before document creation to show actionable error messages
Displays intended quantity instead of 0 in failed creation notifications
Falls back to naming-convention logic only for non-bin-mandatory locations or when item has no current stock
Extracted IsReceiveBin as a reusable helper function
